latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Development Checklist Generator skill.

- Generates concise, effective checklists for code completion, testing, and release processes.
- Focuses on addressing recurring team issues and mistakes, enhancing team quality.
- Guides users to select the right checklist type and identify real pain points before generating.
- Ensures checklists are brief, relevant, and distinct from procedural workflows.
- Includes principles for checklist design that prioritize adoption and usefulness over process overhead.
